title_zh: 航行警告！黄海部分海域将进行军事演练 禁止驶入
title_en: Navigation Warning: Military Exercise to Be Held in Parts of Yellow Sea, Entry Prohibited
summary_zh: 日照海事局9月3日发布航行警告：9月5日8时至8日8时，黄海部分海域将进行军事演练，禁止驶入。
summary_en: Rizhao Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning on Sept. 3: A military exercise will be held in parts of the Yellow Sea from 8:00 Sept. 5 to 8:00 Sept. 8, 2026. Entry is prohibited.
body_zh:
中新网9月3日电 据中国海事局网站消息，日照海事局3日发布航行警告，9月5日8时至8日8时，黄海部分海域进行军事演练，禁止驶入。
